title: IntelliRoute launch — Sales & CS cheat sheets, demo scripts, and release coordination
creator: Lena Torres
description: Create a compact enablement kit for Sales and Customer Success ahead of the IntelliRoute launch. Kit must include one-page battlecards, objection-handling talk tracks (exec and technical), three demo scripts (quick-start, cost-optimization, failover recovery), an FAQ tailored to procurement/legal questions, release-note highlights for external-facing comms, and an internal rapid-response snippet for live demos.
deliverables: 1-page battlecard (customer profiles, key messages, pricing delta, competitive positioning)
Executive talk track (30s elevator + 2-min value pitch)
Technical talk track (architecture, SLOs, fallback behavior)
3x demo scripts: QuickStart, Cost-Focus, Failover Scenario
Sales FAQ document (procurement, SLAs, data residency, private deployment)
Release Notes brief aligned with PM & Eng wording
Recording of enablement walkthrough + slide deck
acceptance_criteria: Battlecard reviewed and signed off by Sales Enablement and Solutions Engineering
Demo scripts validated in at least two dry-runs with SEs and updated based on feedback
FAQ covers the top 10 expected customer questions and has legal-approved wording where required
Release-note highlights approved by Engineering and Docs and ready for publication with the release cut
Enablement session scheduled and recorded; slides uploaded to Drive and linked in the kit
